nodes.body: this PR probably deserves to be split into at least two

nodes.title: Add SPDX license lines and exempt golden traces from the license check

nodes.body: The change this carried is already on main as 663c9b7: the tidy check now excludes ports/*/tools/golden/* (with the comment saying why the traces are left out), and both CMakeLists of the ported tree carry their SPDX line. It landed as a take-over of this very commit (49e62882) while the pull request stood open, so merging would ask git for a merge of a diff main already has. Closing it rather than leaving it to rot; thanks for the fix it was.

nodes.title: the names of the tool calls stand said in the fold

nodes.body: Superseded by #10, which says the names of every call and the asking and the answer beside each -- the very thing this pull request started (#10's body says so itself). Two pull requests saying one thing twice is how they disagree: closing this in favour of #10.

nodes.body: Every pchat test in this one's `check` passes, including the new ones; what fails it is main's own breakage and not this branch: `agora_portable_crypto_test` cannot link on main either (ports/agora-core, missing `agora::core::Sha256Digest`), so nothing built on top of main is green until that is mended. Nothing to do here but wait for it, or carry it: said of it [on main](https://github.com/progressive-chat/progressive-chat/actions/runs/42236101408).

nodes.title: four things chosen where the plus is [probe]
every call an answer asked for, and what it was given back
what a probe is, said once where everybody can read it
what is held taken away, and nothing of it kept anywhere else [probe]
what a fold counted, said one call at a time
the words size themselves, and the boxes around them hold that size
a fold is pressed open, and what it holds is read

nodes.body: Closing as taken by the tree itself: `caecd4b` landed a probe that presses the fold and reads what it opened, and `ecadce5` ticked the TODO item -- both written here in parallel while this request was being verified against a build. What this one added beyond it is said for the record: the four reads of the line (shut, thought behind it, opened, whole again), a walk across the pill step by step saying where a press answers -- which is how the fault was found at all, the line's words silent and only a thumb's width at the pill's left answering -- and `PCHAT_PAGE` support, so the same script asks a ref's own build and not only the deployment. The walk form of it was what proved the sizing fix end to end (flips at every step across the pill, words-press opens: https://github.com/progressive-chat/progressive-chat/actions/runs/42372734963). Happy to re-send the walk as a widening of the probe that landed, if the shape fits.
